resources.string: Guided sessions arrive in a later release. Preview each step below.
Hi! I\'m here to support you. How are you feeling today?
I\'ve been feeling a bit overwhelmed with work lately
Let\'s catch that loop together. What thought keeps coming back?
I keep telling myself I\'m not good enough
Let\'s name the feeling first. What is strongest right now?
Anxious, I think — my chest feels tight
That sounds heavy. What has been weighing on you most this week?
Mostly deadlines — I keep falling behind no matter how hard I try
Falling behind doesn\'t mean you\'re failing. Could we pick one small thing to start with?
Maybe just replying to the messages I\'ve been avoiding
Thank you for naming it. Where did you first learn to speak to yourself that way?
I think it started at school — nothing I did was ever quite enough
That voice was learned, so it can be unlearned. What would you tell a friend who felt this?
I\'d tell them they\'re doing far better than they think
A tight chest is a real signal. Let\'s slow the breath: in for four, out for six.
Okay… doing that now. It feels a little easier
Good. On a scale of one to ten, where is the anxiety sitting now?
Maybe a six, down from an eight
Let\'s start with the smallest one: replying to a single message, nothing more.
Okay, I can do one message tonight
Say that sentence to yourself once, in the second person, the way a friend would.
You are doing better than you think
Then keep the six-count exhale for another minute and check in with me after.
